name: ai-pirates-game
description: An automation-policy simulator with a survey-weighted US electorate and rational, self-interested voters.

scripts.build: npm run precompute && astro build && npm run stage
scripts.check: astro check && node scripts/python-tool.mjs ruff check calculator worker/entry.py scripts/build-precomputed.py scripts/stage-worker.py scripts/check-api.py tests/python
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:python: node scripts/python-tool.mjs python -m unittest discover -s tests/python -v
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/python-tool.mjs pywrangler deploy
